module.name: kind_cluster_create
module.description: Create a kind cluster (1 cp + 4 workers, dual-stack, default CNI off) on the local Docker daemon or a remote host via DOCKER_HOST. Emits BNK cluster-registration outputs.

optional.name: cluster_name
optional.description: Name of the kind cluster to create.

optional.name: ssh_user
optional.description: Optional SSH user from a bare-metal credential template; combined with ssh_host into DOCKER_HOST=ssh://user@host. Empty = use local Docker socket.

optional.name: ssh_host
optional.description: Optional SSH host from a bare-metal credential template; combined with ssh_user into DOCKER_HOST=ssh://user@host. Empty = use local Docker socket.

optional.name: docker_host
optional.description: Optional explicit DOCKER_HOST override (e.g. ssh://user@host or tcp://host:2375). Takes precedence over ssh_user/ssh_host when set.

optional.name: kind_node_image
optional.description: Optional kind node image override (e.g. kindest/node:v1.31.0). Empty = provider default.

key_outputs.name: cluster_id
key_outputs.description: Cluster ID alias for BNK registration.

key_outputs.name: cluster_endpoint
key_outputs.description: Cluster API endpoint reachable from the bnk-forge worker.
